package ssa

import (
	IMPORT_BASE
	"IMPORT_IR"
	"IMPORT_OBJ"
	"IMPORT_SRC"
	"IMPORT_SYS"
	"IMPORT_TYPECHECK"
	"IMPORT_TYPES"
	LOWER_IMPORT
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type snapshotAllocationFrontend struct {
	Frontend
	fn   *ir.Func
	link *obj.Link
	wb   bool
}

func (fe *snapshotAllocationFrontend) Func() *ir.Func { return fe.fn }
func (fe *snapshotAllocationFrontend) Syslook(n string) *obj.LSym {
	return fe.link.Lookup("runtime." + n)
}
func (fe *snapshotAllocationFrontend) UseWriteBarrier() bool       { return fe.wb }
func (*snapshotAllocationFrontend) Log() bool                      { return false }
func (*snapshotAllocationFrontend) Logf(string, ...any)            {}
func (*snapshotAllocationFrontend) Warnl(src.XPos, string, ...any) {}
func (*snapshotAllocationFrontend) Debug_checknil() bool           { return false }
func (*snapshotAllocationFrontend) Fatalf(p src.XPos, s string, a ...any) {
	panic(fmt.Sprintf(s, a...))
}
func (*snapshotAllocationFrontend) SplitSlot(p *LocalSlot, s string, o int64, t *types.Type) LocalSlot {
	return LocalSlot{N: p.N, Type: t, Off: p.Off + o}
}
func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	mode := os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET")
	target := struct {
		arch  string
		os    string
		size  int
		order binary.ByteOrder
	}{strings.Split(mode, "-")[0], "linux", 8, binary.LittleEndian}
	if strings.Contains(mode, "aix") {
		target.os = "aix"
	}
	switch target.arch {
	case "386", "arm", "mips", "mipsle":
		target.size = 4
	}
	switch target.arch {
	case "mips", "mips64", "ppc64", "s390x":
		target.order = binary.BigEndian
	}
	SETUP
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOAMD64 = 1
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOARM.Version = 7
	LOWER_FEATURES.GOPPC64 = 8
	LOWER_FEATURES.GORISCV64 = 20
	switch target.arch {
	case "386":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.I386
	case "amd64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.AMD64
	case "arm64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.ARM64
	case "mips":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.MIPS
	case "ppc64":
		LINK.Arch.Family = sys.PPC64
	}
	ALLOC_FLAGS
	cfg := UP.NewConfig(target.arch, *UP.NewTypes(), LINK, !strings.Contains(mode, "noopt"), false)
	ty := cfg.Types
	pos := LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(src.NewFileBase("allocation.go", "allocation.go"), 10, 1))
	var out []string
	add := func(n string, a ...any) { out = append(out, n+":"+fmt.Sprint(a...)) }
	for _, a := range ALLOC_ARCHS {
		add("arch", a.Name, a.Family, a.ByteOrder, a.PtrSize, a.RegSize, a.MinLC, a.Alignment, a.CanMergeLoads, a.CanJumpTable, a.HasLR, a.FixedFrameSize)
	}

	fresh := func(in, outs []*types.Type, stack bool) (*Func, *snapshotAllocationFrontend, []*Value, *Value) {
		fields := func(ts []*types.Type, prefix string) []*types.Field {
			var fs []*types.Field
			for i, tp := range ts {
				fs = append(fs, TY.NewField(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup(fmt.Sprint(prefix, i)), tp))
			}
			return fs
		}
		fn := GRAPH.NewFunc(pos, pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("fixture"), TY.NewSignature(nil, fields(in, "a"), fields(outs, "r")))
		fn.DeclareParams(true)
		fe := &snapshotAllocationFrontend{fn: fn, link: LINK, wb: true}
		cache := new(Cache)
		cache.Reset()
		f := cfg.NewFunc(fe, cache)
		f.Name = "fixture"
		f.Type = fn.Type()
		f.ABI0 = cfg.ABI0
		f.ABI1 = cfg.ABI1
		f.ABISelf = cfg.ABI1
		if stack {
			f.ABISelf = cfg.ABI0
		}
		f.ABIDefault = f.ABISelf
		f.OwnAux = OwnAuxCall(fn.Linksym(), f.ABISelf.ABIAnalyze(fn.Type(), true))
		f.pass = &pass{name: "calls"}
		b := f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
		f.Entry = b
		b.Pos = pos
		mem := b.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
		f.spSb()
		var args []*Value
		for _, a := range f.OwnAux.abiInfo.InParams() {
			v := b.NewValue0IA(pos, OpArg, a.Type, a.FrameOffset(f.OwnAux.abiInfo), a.Name)
			args = append(args, v)
		}
		return f, fe, args, mem
	}
	finish := func(n string, f *Func) {
		pipeline := []pass{{name: "number lines", fn: numberLines}, {name: "decompose user", fn: decomposeUser}, {name: "opt", fn: opt}, {name: "early deadcode", fn: deadcode}, {name: "expand calls", fn: expandCalls}, {name: "decompose builtin", fn: postExpandCallsDecompose}, {name: "softfloat", fn: softfloat}, {name: "late opt", fn: opt}, {name: "generic deadcode", fn: deadcode}, {name: "writebarrier", fn: writebarrier}, {name: "lower", fn: lower}, {name: "addressing modes", fn: addressingModes}, {name: "late lower", fn: lateLower}, {name: "pair", fn: pair}, {name: "lowered deadcode for cse", fn: deadcode}, {name: "lowered cse", fn: cse}, {name: "elim unread autos", fn: elimUnreadAutos}, {name: "tighten tuple selectors", fn: tightenTupleSelectors}, {name: "lowered deadcode", fn: deadcode}, {name: "checkLower", fn: checkLower}, {name: "loop invariant", fn: licm}, {name: "late phielim and copyelim", fn: copyelim}, {name: "tighten", fn: tighten}, {name: "late deadcode", fn: deadcode}, {name: "critical", fn: critical}, {name: "phi tighten", fn: phiTighten}, {name: "likelyadjust", fn: likelyadjust}, {name: "layout", fn: layout}, {name: "schedule", fn: schedule}, {name: "late nilcheck", fn: nilcheckelim2}, {name: "flagalloc", fn: flagalloc}, {name: "regalloc", fn: regalloc}, {name: "loop rotate", fn: loopRotate}, {name: "trim", fn: trim}}
		checkFunc(f)
		for _, p := range pipeline {
			f.pass = &p
			p.fn(f)
			checkFunc(f)
			if p.name == "expand calls" || p.name == "lower" || p.name == "pair" || p.name == "schedule" || p.name == "late nilcheck" || p.name == "flagalloc" || p.name == "regalloc" || p.name == "trim" {
				add(n+"/"+p.name, f.String())
			}
		}
		fe := f.Frontend().(*snapshotAllocationFrontend)
		for _, n := range fe.fn.Dcl {
			add("decl", n.Sym().Name, n.Class, n.Type(), n.NonMergeable())
		}
		for id, loc := range f.RegAlloc {
			if loc != nil {
				add("alloc", id, loc.String())
			}
		}
		add("slots", f.Names)
		add("regargs", f.RegArgs)
		add("flags", f.scheduled, f.RegAlloc != nil)
	}
	// Values live across a call require real spill homes and reloads in both banks.
	for _, stack := range []bool{false, true} {
		var ins []*types.Type
		for i := 0; i < 24; i++ {
			ins = append(ins, ty.UInt64, ty.Float64)
		}
		f, _, args, mem := fresh(ins, []*types.Type{ty.UInt64, ty.Float64}, stack)
		b := f.Entry
		aux := StaticAuxCall(LINK.Lookup("callee"), f.ABIDefault.ABIAnalyzeTypes([]*types.Type{ty.UInt64}, []*types.Type{ty.UInt64, ty.Float64}))
		call := b.NewValue2A(pos, OpStaticLECall, aux.LateExpansionResultType(), aux, args[0], mem)
		sum := b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, ty.UInt64, 0, call)
		fp := b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, ty.Float64, 1, call)
		mem = b.NewValue1I(pos, OpSelectN, TY.TypeMem, 2, call)
		for i := 0; i < len(args); i += 2 {
			sum = b.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd64, ty.UInt64, sum, args[i])
			fp = b.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd64F, ty.Float64, fp, args[i+1])
		}
		b.SetControl(b.NewValue3(pos, OpMakeResult, TY.NewResults([]*types.Type{ty.UInt64, ty.Float64, TY.TypeMem}), sum, fp, mem))
		finish(fmt.Sprint("pressure-stack-", stack), f)
	}
	// A critical edge into a phi join must be split before allocation.
	{
		f, _, a, mem := fresh([]*types.Type{ty.Bool, ty.UInt64, ty.UInt64}, []*types.Type{ty.UInt64}, false)
		e := f.Entry
		e.Kind = BlockIf
		e.SetControl(a[0])
		l, j := f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
		l.Pos = pos
		j.Pos = pos
		e.AddEdgeTo(j)
		e.AddEdgeTo(l)
		l.AddEdgeTo(j)
		v := l.NewValue2(pos, OpXor64, ty.UInt64, a[1], a[2])
		p := j.NewValue2(pos, OpPhi, ty.UInt64, a[1], v)
		j.SetControl(j.NewValue2(pos, OpMakeResult, TY.NewResults([]*types.Type{ty.UInt64, TY.TypeMem}), p, mem))
		finish("critical-phi", f)
	}
	// Loop-carried scalars and memory, with invariant arithmetic and two exits.
	{
		f, _, a, mem := fresh([]*types.Type{ty.Int32, TY.NewPtr(ty.Int64), ty.Int64, ty.Int64}, []*types.Type{ty.Int64}, false)
		e := f.Entry
		e.Kind = BlockPlain
		h, body, end := f.NewBlock(BlockIf), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
		for _, b := range []*Block{h, body, end} {
			b.Pos = pos
		}
		e.AddEdgeTo(h)
		h.AddEdgeTo(body)
		h.AddEdgeTo(end)
		body.AddEdgeTo(h)
		i := h.NewValue1(pos, OpPhi, ty.Int32, f.ConstInt32(ty.Int32, 0))
		i.AddArg(body.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd32, ty.Int32, i, f.ConstInt32(ty.Int32, 1)))
		h.SetControl(h.NewValue2(pos, OpLess32, ty.Bool, i, a[0]))
		x := h.NewValue1(pos, OpPhi, ty.Int64, a[2])
		inv := body.NewValue2(pos, OpMul64, ty.Int64, a[2], a[3])
		x.AddArg(body.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd64, ty.Int64, x, inv))
		m := h.NewValue1(pos, OpPhi, TY.TypeMem, mem)
		m.AddArg(body.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, ty.Int64, a[1], x, m))
		end.SetControl(end.NewValue2(pos, OpMakeResult, TY.NewResults([]*types.Type{ty.Int64, TY.TypeMem}), x, m))
		finish("loop", f)
	}
	// Adjacent loads/stores, indexed addressing and a removable nil check.
	{
		f, _, a, mem := fresh([]*types.Type{TY.NewPtr(ty.Int64), TY.NewPtr(ty.Int64), ty.Uintptr}, nil, false)
		b := f.Entry
		ptr := b.NewValue2(pos, OpNilCheck, a[0].Type, a[0], mem)
		x := b.NewValue2(pos, OpLoad, ty.Int64, ptr, mem)
		next := b.NewValue1I(pos, OpOffPtr, ptr.Type, 8, ptr)
		y := b.NewValue2(pos, OpLoad, ty.Int64, next, mem)
		mem = b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, ty.Int64, a[1], x, mem)
		mem = b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, ty.Int64, b.NewValue1I(pos, OpOffPtr, a[1].Type, 8, a[1]), y, mem)
		indexed := b.NewValue2(pos, OpAddPtr, a[1].Type, a[1], a[2])
		b.SetControl(b.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, ty.Int64, indexed, b.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd64, ty.Int64, x, y), mem))
		finish("memory-pairs-index-nil", f)
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("SYNCGO_IR=%s\n", data)
}
